what: First-visit loader — the logo symbol lines are drawn at 10x size covering the screen, rotated ±90°, over 4.5s (cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1)). After 1.125s they shrink to .5x over 2.925s (.83,0,.17,1), and after another 1.35s they stand upright over 2.7s (.77,0,.175,1). At 4.5s the symbol cell opens out to the neighboring wordmark over 1.5s, and at 7.2s the curtain lifts — background .3s (after .1s), logo .5s (after .25s), and two background-colored petal blobs shrink to .5x, turn and move away in one of four directions (2s) and go off at 1.75s (fx:open). 1.3s later fx:done fires. With key given, from the second visit in the same session nothing is drawn and only the petals move away

options.key: Given a name, it draws only once per session — from the second time, only the petals move aside (original cookie)
options.hold: From the start of drawing to lifting the veil (seconds), default 7.2 — shorten it for screens opened often, like apps
options.delay: Delay from opening to start of drawing (sec), default .2
options.settle: Time from when the curtain starts lifting until fx:done (s), default 1.3
options.petal: Number of paths 1~4 where petals part, default random (original)
options.turn: Faces 1·2 stand up at 90°, faces 3·4 at -90°, default random (original)
options.--fx-mark: Symbol column width (via style), default 22.9167vw (330px at 1440) · phone 40vw
options.--fx-veil · --fx-ink · --fx-petal: Curtain color · logo color · petal mask shape, default --kf-bg · --kf-ink · five-petal cluster
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: Plate holding two petals — child [data-fx-part=petal] two (the first moves aside to the bottom left of the screen, the second to the top right)
options.[data-fx-part=logo] > [data-fx-part=set]: Shrinking cells inside the rotating logo plate — child [data-fx-part=mark] (svg containing a line path) and [data-fx-part=type](wordmark)
options.fx:open · fx:done: When the curtain starts to lift (original body.active — the Hero image 1.2→1x happens here), and when it is fully lifted and the curtain is removed (original contentsready)

use: Brand Name
note: The original lifts the curtain after the first-screen images have finished loading (imagesLoaded) — this part only watches time. Scrolling is not blocked meanwhile (in the original, the document under the curtain scrolls too)
